messages:
Nina (Recruiter): Ava accepted L4 offer with $12k sign-on. She just asked to move start up two weeks to 2026-04-20 due to childcare.
Carlos (Hiring Manager): I can shift onboarding dates. Manager asks if we can pay 60% of sign-on on first run to help with childcare.
Ivy (People Ops): Frontload 60% is an exception to standard schedule. Needs comp approval, legal amendment, and payroll PR.
Nina (Recruiter): Candidate prefers frontload, says she can sign amendment same day.
PeopleOps-Bot: New request REQ-2026-2110 created: "60% frontload sign-on for early childcare start". Routing: Comp -> Legal -> Payroll. SLA 2bd for expedited.
Theo (Comp): Quick check: band unchanged, base comp same. 60% ok for hardship accommodation. Please add manager note re: retention risk.
Legal-Bot: Amendment template ready: AMEND-601. Includes payment schedule and 90-day clawback.
Payroll Bot: To hit 2026-04-20 payroll we need PR and signed amendment by 04/16 10:00 PT. Otherwise next run 05/04.
Ivy (People Ops): I'll escalate to comp chair for fast-track.
Theo (Comp): Approved. Adding comp chair sign-off.
Nina (Recruiter): Amendment signed by Ava and attached. PR submitted.
Payroll Bot: PR#601-FL received. Scheduling $7,200 on 04/20 and remainder on 07/01.
Ivy (People Ops): All set. Start date updated to 2026-04-20. Noting exception in candidate record.
Carlos (Hiring Manager): Thanks team, onboarding updated.
Nina (Recruiter): Ava confirmed start and is grateful :heart:
